home.title: The Prince St Kilda; Iconic Pub, Hotel & Live Music Venue
home.metaDesc: An iconic St Kilda pub, boutique hotel and live music venue since 1936. Eat, drink, stay and experience Melbourne culture at The Prince.
home.text: Skip to: Home Content Footer navigation Get $10 off your first order with The Pass - Download the app LITTLE PRINCE WINE STAY BANDROOM MEET THE WINEMAKERS PRIVATE EVENTS CONTACT - BOOK A ROOM VIEW GIG GUIDE Welcome to The Prince Since 1936, The Prince has been an iconic pub, boutique hotel and live music venue in St Kilda, Melbourne. From its grand art deco beginnings to its role in Melbourne’s cultural evolution, The Prince has long been a cornerstone of the city’s social and music scene. Today, The Prince Hotel & Public Bar remains a true local favourite — a place to enjoy a pub meal and drinks in St Kilda, discover curated wines at Little Prince Wine, stay in a boutique hotel near St Kilda Beach, or experience live music at one of Melbourne’s most loved bandrooms. Classic, character-filled and always buzzing, The Prince is where locals and visitors come together for food, drinks, accommodation and live entertainment in Melbourne. accommodation.title: Stay at The Prince St Kilda; Boutique Hotel Rooms & Suites
accommodation.metaDesc: An iconic boutique hotel in St Kilda; art-filled rooms and suites, live music, rooftop terrace, and steps from the beach and Acland Street.
accommodation.text: Skip to: Home Content Footer navigation Get $10 off your first order with The Pass - Download the app LITTLE PRINCE WINE STAY BANDROOM MEET THE WINEMAKERS PRIVATE EVENTS CONTACT BOOK A ROOM - BOOK A ROOM Check in: Check out: Adults: 1 2 3 4 Children: 0 1 2 FIND A ROOM Stay at The Prince One of St Kilda’s most iconic stays, The Prince offers more than just rooms. Enjoy live music in our intimate Bandroom, grab a drink at our classic Art Deco bars, or soak up the city skyline from our rooftop terrace. Our walls showcase a curated collection of contemporary Australian art, and we’re just steps from the beach, Acland Street’s cafes and shops, and the vibrant heart of St Kilda.
